v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

text.la: Assúmpsit Iesus * Petrum, et Iacóbum, et Ioánnem fratrem eius, et duxit eos in montem excélsum seórsum, et transfigurátus est ante eos.
text.en: Jesus took Peter, * and James, and John his brother, and brought them up into an high mountain apart and was transfigured before them.

text.la: Resplénduit * fácies eius sicut sol, vestiménta autem eius facta sunt alba sicut nix, allelúia.
text.en: His Face did shine as the sun, * and His raiment exceeding white as snow, alleluia.

text.la: Et ecce * apparuérunt eis Móyses et Elías loquéntes cum Iesu.
text.en: And, behold, there appeared unto them Moses and Elias, * talking with Jesus.

text.la: Respóndens autem Petrus, * dixit ad Iesum: Dómine, bonum est nos hic esse.
text.en: Then answered Peter, * and said unto Jesus: Lord, it is good for us to be here.

text.la: Adhuc eo loquénte, * ecce nubes lúcida obumbrávit eos.
text.en: While he yet spake, * behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them.

text.la: Salvatórem exspectámus Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, qui reformábit corpus humilitátis nostræ configurátum córpori claritátis suæ.
text.en: We look for the Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ, Who shall change our vile body, that it may be fashioned like unto His glorious Body.

v.en: Thou wast manifested in thy glory in the Presence of the Lord.

r.en: Therefore the Lord hath clothed thee with majesty.

text.la: Christus Iesus, * splendor Patris et figúra substántiæ eius, portans ómnia verbo virtútis suæ, purgatiónem peccatórum fáciens, in monte excélso gloriósus apparére hódie dignátus est.
text.en: Christ Jesus, being the Brightness * of the Father's glory, and the express Image of His Person, and upholding all things by the word of His power, when He was about purging our sins, was pleased, as on this day, to manifest forth His glory upon an high mountain.

text.la: Deus, qui fídei sacraménta in Unigéniti tui gloriósa Transfiguratióne patrum testimónio roborásti, et adoptiónem filiórum perféctam, voce delápsa in nube lúcida, mirabíliter præsignásti: concéde propítius; ut ipsíus Regis glóriæ nos coherédes effícias, et eiúsdem glóriæ tríbuas esse consórtes.
text.en: O God, Who, in the glorious Transfiguration of thine Only Begotten Son didst attest the mysteries of the Faith by the witness of the Fathers, and didst wonderfully signify by a voice out of a bright cloud, the adoption of sons, mercifully grant unto us to be made co-heirs with the very King of glory, and bestow upon us a partaking of His glory.
